reports.scope: Qwen3.5-2B FP32 on one logical Ascend 910C device. Three offline workloads, one warmup per path and three alternating paired measurements. Identical outputs, input-token work and clean final caches across 24 runs; 344 forwards including warmups. CPU-commit latency and whole-workload throughput.
